title: Graphing a Right-Shifted Reciprocal Hyperbola
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Analyze and describe the graph of y = 1 / (x - 2) by identifying its parent function, shift, asymptotes, domain, range, and intercepts.

steps.title: Identify the Parent Function and Horizontal Shift
steps.explanation: Replacing x with x - 2 in the parent reciprocal function y = 1/x shifts the hyperbola 2 units to the right.
steps.why: A horizontal shift right by 2 units replaces x with x - 2.

steps.title: Determine the Asymptotes, Domain, and Range
steps.explanation: The vertical asymptote shifts from x = 0 to x = 2 (where the denominator vanishes), while the horizontal asymptote remains the x-axis y = 0.
steps.why: Horizontal translation moves vertical asymptotes by the shift amount while leaving horizontal asymptotes invariant.

steps.title: Find the y-Intercept and Guide Points
steps.explanation: The left branch lies below the x-axis passing through (0, -1/2) and (1, -1); the right branch lies in the first quadrant passing through (3, 1) and (4, 1/2).
steps.why: Evaluating at x = 0, 1, 3 determines the exact position of the two hyperbolic branches.
